title: Design Release Engineer
description:
Job Description:

  • The Design and Release Engineer (DRE) Driveline & Axle Product Release Center acts as the owner of assigned driveline & axle components (e.g. Axles, RDM, PTU, T-Case, prop shaft, half shaft, brackets, etc.).
  • Executes product design, analysis, release and testing per technical infrastructure and Client PCPC (the "how”).

Responsibilities:
  • Responsible for the complete design and product delivery against technical requirements for the assigned components and products. Components and products may be complex, or include new technology, requiring related and relevant prior experience.
  • Develop subject matter expertise for select components or assemblies as assigned
  • Coach entry level engineers as required
  • Recognized as a single point of contact for suppliers' product engineering.
  • Manages and tracks supplier product engineering activities and deliverables, including supplier test plans and test execution.
  • Prepares product engineering work plans in accordance with program and project timing and milestones.
  • Completes and documents for advanced analysis and simulation of actuation mechanisms, including electro-mechanical and servo-hydraulic subsystems.
  • Executes engineering deliverables in adherence to technical infrastructure and product development process deliverables, reviews, signoffs, and report-outs, including:
  • Develops technical requirements for components and subsystems of driveline & axles including purchased assemblies.
  • Completes all required technical source package documentation to support supplier quotes
  • Evaluates designs to the engineering best practice documents and completes supplier design reviews
  • Captures all lessons learned, and ensures timely execution of all calculations, analysis, and simulation in alignment with test plans and requirements
  • Develops DFMEAs and evaluates designs for failure modes robustness
  • Develops and executes component and subsystem DVP&R plans to validate all aspects of new designs and design changes, including DRBTR.
  • Supports the development of the system DVP&Rs
  • Develops tools, test procedures and acceptance criteria for driveline & axles, components, subassemblies and purchased assemblies
  • Collaborates appropriate design detailing and CAE activities
  • Ensures transfer functions and physics-based analysis are defined and documented for all actuation subsystems and components.
  • Delivers EBOM, models, drawings for components, subassemblies, and purchased assemblies
  • Generates engineering documentation in support of change management, including DRBFM
  • Delivers parts / hardware to pilot builds, including requisitions for prototypes and ED&D.
  • Collaborates with transmission and driveline systems subject matter experts, ACEs, DSEs, AEs, and other stakeholders to address and support any failures using the appropriate tools and processes.
  • Prepares status reports and presentations for management and CE organization
  • Supports manufacturing on production-related issues
  • Generates cost reduction ideas and develops and executes corresponding design and validation plans.
  • Participate in warranty/cost reduction meetings and develops solutions for warranty issues
  • Conducts root cause analysis of driveline & axles failures and identify the root cause/s
  • Conducts Layered Process Audits at supplier plants for assigned components.

Requirements:
  • 5 years experience minimum
  • Bachelor of Mechanical/ Mechatronics/Electrical Engineering degree or similar
  • 2 years of experience in the automotive industry or product engineering design, validation and engineering projects development with OEM and/or tier(n) suppliers. OR a high potential College graduate with good knowledge about Automotive industry and driveline/Axles components / subsystems.
  • Thorough understanding of vehicle functions and general vehicle architecture
  • Understanding of typical automotive manufacturing and quality processes
  • Advanced English language skills 90% (Read and Write).
  • Proficient with MS Office.


Preferred Qualifications:
  • Master's degree in mechanical/ Mechatronics/Electrical Engineering highly desired
  • Green/Black Belt in Shainin or DFSS
  • Experience in transmission, driveline & axles or related area
  • Knowledge of Client Systems and/or products a plus
  • CAE/CFD experiences with Powertrain structures
  • Experience with the fundamentals of CAN communications
  • Experience with electric motors for automotive applications
  • Knowledge of Casting and Injection Molding processes.
  • Other languages: Italian or French

Must Have's:
  • Design / Development Experience of Driveline / Axles
  • Validation (DVP&R)
  • Technical Program Management

Travel:
  • % of travel: 20% - Local and/or Canada

title: Safety Coordinator
description:
Job Summary:

  • Conduct emergency drills and training to ensure readiness.
  • Serve as point of contact for emergency services when necessary.
  • Promote a culture of safety and environmental stewardship through communication, recognition, and employee engagement.

  • Recommend process improvements to reduce hazards and environmental impact.

  • In-depth knowledge of OSHA, EPA, NFPA, and other applicable regulations.
  • Strong computer skills and familiar with Microsoft Office Suite
  • 3+ years of HSE experience in manufacturing, heavy industry, or oil & gas
